name: popsicle
headline: n8n-nodes-late - Automate Social Media Management
short_description: The n8n-nodes-late skill integrates the LATE API with n8n workflows, allowing marketing teams to automate social media scheduling, publishing, and management across multiple platforms. Connects to n8n for streamlined content management.
author: getlate-dev

sections.overview:
The n8n-nodes-late skill (also available as n8n-nodes-zernio) integrates the Zernio API with n8n workflows to automate social media management. It enables teams to schedule, publish, and manage posts across Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Reddit, Telegram, Google Business, and Snapchat from a single interface. The node supports advanced operations including profile management, bulk uploads, media handling, account grouping, analytics tracking, and platform-specific features like Twitter threads and YouTube daily view statistics. Teams can organize accounts by brand or client through profiles, connect multiple social accounts, schedule posts with timezone support, monitor engagement metrics, and manage team access—all within their existing n8n automation workflows.
Schedule and publish marketing campaigns across 13+ social platforms simultaneously
Automate content distribution for multiple client accounts or brand profiles
Monitor social media analytics and follower statistics within workflows
Manage team access and bulk upload multiple posts with queue scheduling
- **Trigger**: Scheduled posts at optimal times
- **Actions**: Publish to Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn
- **Data Source**: [DATA]
- **Engagement Tracking**: Real-time analytics
